description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams' which extends 'LeaveTypeSearchFilterParams' and includes a date range trait. It represents a data transfer object (DTO) used to encapsulate search filter parameters, specifically for filtering employee leave balance data by employee number along with other inherited filter parameters.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveBalanceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to employee leave balances, including employee number and inherited date range filters.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the filter.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number for the filter.
